summary: Market mood is cautiously bullish on crypto, with several analysts still favoring selective altcoin exposure over broad risk-taking. The strongest fresh themes in the gathered material are altcoin rotation, AI/infrastructure narratives, and a constructive BTC backdrop with some near-term correction risk.

signals.reason: The titles repeatedly frame Bitcoin as a trap, short squeeze, resistance, or a shorting opportunity, while the buy-title appears conditional on a sweep/re-accumulation rather than an outright bullish breakout.
